RECLASSIFIED from the assumed 'runtime data API' bucket: models.dev/logos/<slug>.svg is a static SVG file host (verified via curl: fast, deterministic, image/svg+xml, no per-request variability), functionally identical in kind to cdn.simpleicons.org. `provider` is a free-form string prop on a reusable primitive (ModelSelectorLogoProps allows `string & {}`), so it is unbounded in general -- pre-generated only the 14 chefSlug values actually referenced by the example files (alibaba, amazon-bedrock, anthropic, cohere, deepseek, google, llama, mistral, moonshotai, openai, perplexity, v0, xai, cerebras). Any other provider string passed by a downstream consumer of this component will still 404 locally -- this residual is documented, not hidden.

https://unpkg.com/@rive-app/webgl2@2.39.2/rive.wasm and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@rive-app/webgl2@2.39.2/rive_fallback.wasm are NOT literal strings in this source file -- they are hardcoded defaults inside the @rive-app/webgl2 library's RuntimeLoader (see node_modules/.pnpm/@rive-app+webgl2@2.39.2/.../rive.js). Added @rive-app/webgl2 as an explicit _verify dependency (pnpm add) to import RuntimeLoader and call the library's own override API (setWasmUrl/setWasmFallbackUrl) at module load, pointing at the two wasm files vendored from the same package version. Requires `pnpm add @rive-app/webgl2@2.39.2` in _verify (already applied).
